asr.full_text: Assalam o Alaikum, My name is Rikzahid. Today we are present in Gulmohde city. There is a question, we reply to it. Many people asked us in our questions How long the location of Gulmohde city will last and while it will be built. All the projects in the M9 series also named for Gulmohde city. In front of us is Al-Qaim and ASF city. In front of us is Commander city. In front of us is phase 2 of Be Sai mahmid town, then Romi. Then in a very close bihariya town, there is a king city. And many more projects have been launched nearby, so what is their future like? How long can they abide? And when can the expectation be kept? If you invest here, then your plan is that you will definitely be able to get a shift in the next 2-3 years or 5 years. So you can plan for your children that in the condition in which you are living, at least your children do not have to live, they have such an opportunity that if they want to shift here tomorrow, business opportunities increase here and the opportunities to earn, the opportunities to do business come here. So come here and make a house for yourself can come here and build a house and live here and also do their business and come out of a city like Karachi and come to a better place and enjoy your life So, it is necessary that if someone comes here then they have business opportunities because it is very difficult for them to travel for you daily from far away like Karachi There'll be all offices and other basic things We'll first provide all of them and along with all this school, college , Mosque You'll get to see all of these things before possession and for safety, security system You'll get all these things in time Now it's upto you how much parts you'll take and how much time you invest as you invest and buy properties So you might get better in the future you may get good return and you may get the plot. you buy plot in the front block, there you purchase the main entry It matters that which project you should come for, that the project is facing the main road of the bike This matters a lot for you when you come to any project they are all front limited Invent on these limited properties Invest on our premium block On internal block we have recently launched Invent in this one and InshaALLAH you will get a good return so please contact us and grab the perfect opportunity for yourself. Thank you for being with me. Thank you so much. God bless!
